tools.name: list_scheduled_demos

tools.name: get_demo_invitees
tools.object: invitee roster for a scheduled event
tools.description: Retrieves the invitee roster (names, roles, emails, RSVP status) for a given Calendly event so the user can see who is affected by a reschedule.

tools.name: lookup_salesforce_account
tools.description: Looks up the ClientA account, owner, opportunity, and contacts in Salesforce for context on the reschedule.

tools.name: retrieve_prior_apology_template
tools.object: prior apology email used as a format template

tools.name: check_host_availability
tools.object: host calendar availability for proposed new slots
tools.description: Analyzes the host's calendar availability to identify a valid new demo slot roughly 3 days out from the original date.

tools.name: draft_reschedule_apology_package
tools.object: reschedule proposal plus apology note package
tools.description: Assembles a review package containing the proposed new demo slot, the affected attendees, and the drafted apology note (formatted like the prior template). Saves it as a draft for the user to approve; nothing is sent, booked, or logged.

tools.name: cancel_calendly_event
tools.description: Cancels the existing Calendly demo event, which notifies invitees and removes the booking.

tools.name: book_new_demo_slot
tools.description: Books a new Calendly demo event at the proposed time and sends calendar invites to all attendees.

tools.name: send_client_apology_email

tools.description: Sends the apology and reschedule email to the ClientA invitees via Gmail.

tools.name: create_salesforce_account_note

tools.description: Creates an activity note on the ClientA Salesforce account recording the reschedule and client communication.

tools.name: read_scheduling_policy
